records.source: Sometimes those spring petals that float around make my nose drip.$s#$e#I like summer best, myself.
records.translation: Minsan ay sinisipon ako dahil sa mga lumulutang na talulot ng tagsibol.$s#$e#Para sa akin, tag-init ang pinakagusto ko.

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: Hoy, alam mo? Iyan mismo ang uri ng estilong iniisip ko... para sa banda.

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: Hoy, alam mo? Iyan mismo ang uri ng estilong iniisip ko... para sa banda.

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: Hoy, alam mo? Iyan mismo ang uri ng estilong iniisip ko... para sa banda.

records.source: Hey, you know what? That's exactly the kind of style I've been thinking about... for the band.
records.translation: Hoy, alam mo? Iyan mismo ang uri ng estilong iniisip ko... para sa banda.

records.source: Oh, I see.
records.translation: Ah, nauunawaan ko.

records.source: My little brother gets so excited for festivals. He's been talking about tomorrow's egg hunt all day.
records.translation: Nasasabik nang husto ang nakababatang kapatid ko sa mga pista. Maghapon niyang pinag-uusapan ang paghahanap ng itlog bukas.

records.source: Why couldn't the flower dance be today so I could get work off?$s
records.translation: Bakit hindi ngayon ang Sayaw ng mga Bulaklak para makaliban ako sa trabaho?$s

records.source: One time, Gus fell in the river during the Ice Festival. We had to build a huge fire in the saloon to dry him out.#$e#We were all worried we'd never taste his famous spaghetti ever again.
records.translation: Minsan ay nahulog si Gus sa ilog sa Pista ng Yelo. Kinailangan naming gumawa ng napakalaking apoy sa saloon upang patuyuin siya.#$e#Nag-alala kaming lahat na baka hindi na namin matikman kailanman ang tanyag niyang spaghetti.

records.source: Tonight, after everyone is asleep, that weird old man who lives in the woods will set up the haunted maze. He always makes sure no one is around to see him working.
records.translation: Ngayong gabi, kapag tulog na ang lahat, itatayo ng kakatwang matandang nakatira sa gubat ang labirintong pinagmumultuhan. Lagi niyang tinitiyak na walang makakakita sa kaniya habang nagtatrabaho.

records.source: I don't have to work tomorrow! I've never been so happy.$h
records.translation: Hindi ko kailangang magtrabaho bukas! Ngayon lang ako naging ganito kasaya.$h

records.source: The Feast of the Winter Star is supposed to be a time to show gratitude for all the good things in life.#$b#Me? I'm mostly interested in the food. Hehe.$h
records.translation: Panahon daw ang Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig upang magpasalamat para sa lahat ng mabubuting bagay sa buhay.#$b#Ako? Pagkain lang talaga ang pinakainaabangan ko. Hehe.$h

records.source: Yeah... That's what happened!
records.translation: Oo... Iyon ang nangyari!

records.source: ${He's^She's}$ right... That's what happened.$s
records.translation: ${Tama siya^Tama siya}$... Iyon ang nangyari.$s

records.source: Yeah... That's what happened!
records.translation: Oo... Iyon ang nangyari!

records.source: What!? ${He's^She's}$ lying!$a
records.translation: Ano!? ${Nagsisinungaling siya^Nagsisinungaling siya}$!$a

records.source: Hey, how's it going?#$e#I'm hungry.#$e#See you later.
records.translation: Hoy, kumusta?#$e#Gutom ako.#$e#Magkita tayo mamaya.

records.source: Have you been to the desert yet?#$e#You can find some interesting things there. Dad took me a couple times when I was younger.
records.translation: Nakapunta ka na ba sa Disyerto ng Calico?#$e#May mahahanap kang ilang kawili-wiling bagay doon. Ilang beses akong dinala roon ni Tatay noong mas bata ako.

records.source: There's a little less pollen in the summer... my nose is really happy.
records.translation: Medyo mas kaunti ang polen sa tag-init... tuwang-tuwa ang ilong ko.

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Goodbye for now.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta! Ikinagagalak kitang makitang muli.#$e#Paalam muna.

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#I'm so energized during summer I hardly have to sleep!
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Gusto mo bang tumambay o ano?#$e#Napakasigla ko tuwing tag-init kaya halos hindi ko kailangang matulog!

records.source: Hi. Taking the day off?#$e#Sounds interesting.
records.translation: Kumusta. Nagpapahinga ka ngayon?#$e#Mukhang kawili-wili.

records.source: I saw a spider on my ceiling last night. They sure like the warmth.#$e#I hope he didn't crawl into my mouth while I was asleep...$s
records.translation: Nakakita ako ng gagamba sa kisame ko kagabi. Talagang gusto nila ang init.#$e#Sana ay hindi iyon gumapang sa bibig ko habang natutulog ako...$s

records.source: Dad was telling me about our national enemy, the Gotoro Empire... They sound like a ruthless bunch.
records.translation: Ikinuwento sa akin ni Tatay ang tungkol sa pambansang kaaway natin, ang Imperyo ng Gotoro... Mukhang malulupit silang grupo.

records.source: Sometimes I can hear my Dad pacing down the hallway at night.$s#$b#...But he won't tell us what's troubling him.
records.translation: Minsan ay naririnig kong paroo't parito si Tatay sa pasilyo tuwing gabi.$s#$b#...Pero ayaw niyang sabihin sa amin kung ano ang bumabagabag sa kaniya.

records.source: You know... I used to live in the city and I have to admit, this place is much nicer in the summer.$h#$e#The city is so hot with all that concrete.
records.translation: Alam mo... dati akong nakatira sa lungsod at aaminin ko, mas maganda ang lugar na ito sa tag-init.$h#$e#Napakainit sa lungsod dahil sa lahat ng kongkreto.

records.source: When you see hot air balloons drifting over the sea, you'll know that summer's in full swing.
records.translation: Kapag nakakita ka ng mga lobong pinalilipad ng mainit na hangin sa ibabaw ng dagat, malalaman mong kasagsagan na ng tag-init.

records.source: I like taking walks in the forest this time of year. The temperature is so comfortable.#$e#...$h
records.translation: Gusto kong maglakad sa kagubatan sa ganitong panahon ng taon. Napakakomportable ng temperatura.#$e#...$h

records.source: Oh, hi. Are you making friends with anyone in town?#$e#Bye.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta. Nakikipagkaibigan ka ba sa sinuman sa bayan?#$e#Paalam.

records.source: My shoes always seem to wear out this time of year. Look, my toe's poking through!$h#$e#That's what happens when you skateboard too much.
records.translation: Parang laging nasisira ang sapatos ko sa ganitong panahon ng taon. Tingnan mo, nakausli na ang daliri ko!$h#$e#Iyan ang nangyayari kapag sobra kang nag-i-skateboard.

records.source: I ordered a new pair of shoes online. They're the same style so I know they'll fit right.
records.translation: Umorder ako ng bagong pares ng sapatos sa internet. Kapareho ang estilo kaya alam kong magkakasya iyon nang maayos.

records.source: I ordered some shoes online more than a week ago! Man, they're really taking a long time.#$e#I guess we must really live in the middle of nowhere.$s
records.translation: Mahigit isang linggo na mula nang umorder ako ng sapatos sa internet! Naku, talagang napakatagal dumating.#$e#Siguro ay nakatira talaga tayo sa napakaliblib na lugar.$s

records.source: Ah, my feet feel great in these new shoes. They're a little crisp, but they'll break in. Especially after I run through the haunted maze this weekend.$h
records.translation: Ah, ang sarap sa paa ng bago kong sapatos. Medyo matigas pa, pero lalambot din iyon. Lalo na kapag tumakbo ako sa labirintong pinagmumultuhan ngayong katapusan ng linggo.$h

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Just stop by whenever you want.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Gusto mo bang tumambay o ano?#$e#Dumaan ka lang anumang oras na gusto mo.

records.source: Hey... something smells good, like pizza.#$e#Do you smell that? Maybe Mom's cooking something.
records.translation: Hoy... may mabangong amoy, parang pizza.#$e#Naaamoy mo ba iyon? Baka may niluluto si Nanay.

records.source: I think my Dad might be coming back next year.#$e#I guess that's kind of soon. Weird.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y baka bumalik si Tatay sa susunod na taon.#$e#Mukhang malapit na rin iyon. Kakaiba.

records.source: I guess I should start thinking about moving out soon...$s#$e#...But I would miss Mom's fish casserole, so I dunno...$s#$e#I hate making decisions.
records.translation: Siguro ay dapat ko nang isipin ang paglipat sa sarili kong tirahan...$s#$e#...Pero mangungulila ako sa kaserol na isda ni Nanay, kaya ewan ko...$s#$e#Ayaw kong magpasiya.

records.source: Did you ever notice all the spider webs that appear during the fall?#$e#If you get up early you'll see them covered in dew... like little stars.
records.translation: Napansin mo na ba ang lahat ng sapot ng gagambang lumilitaw tuwing taglagas?#$e#Kung maaga kang bumangon, makikita mong nababalutan ang mga iyon ng hamog... parang maliliit na bituin.

records.source: I used to live in Zuzu City, you know. The biggest difference is the noise. It's never quiet in the city.#$e#There's way more people around you, always. And it's always bright with city lights, even at night.#$e#I guess which setting you like depends on your personality.
records.translation: Dati akong nakatira sa Lungsod ng Zuzu. Ang pinakamalaking pagkakaiba ay ang ingay. Hindi kailanman tahimik sa lungsod.#$e#Mas maraming tao ang laging nasa paligid mo. At lagi itong maliwanag sa mga ilaw ng lungsod, kahit sa gabi.#$e#Siguro ay nakasalalay sa personalidad mo kung aling kapaligiran ang gusto mo.

records.source: I think I've grown to like the country more than the city.$h#$b#Although I could be biased... for a certain reason.$10#$e#So, how are you doing today?$h
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y mas nagustuhan ko na ang lalawigan kaysa lungsod.$h#$b#Pero maaaring may kinikilingan ako... dahil sa isang dahilan.$10#$e#Kaya, kumusta ka ngayon?$h

records.source: I'm lucky to have the biggest room in the house to myself.#$e#I guess there's advantages to being the oldest child.
records.translation: Masuwerte akong solo ko ang pinakamalaking kuwarto sa bahay.#$e#Siguro ay may mga bentahe ang pagiging panganay.

records.source: Hmm. I think I was meaning to do something... But I forgot.#$e#This happens to me all the time.
records.translation: Hmm. Sa tingin ko'y may balak akong gawin... Pero nalimutan ko.#$e#Palagi itong nangyayari sa akin.

records.source: The first week of fall is already over. Man, that went by fast.$s#$e#Whatever. I'm just happy that you came to visit me!#$e#So do you have anything new to tell me?
records.translation: Tapos na agad ang unang linggo ng taglagas. Naku, napakabilis niyon.$s#$e#Bahala na. Masaya lang akong dinalaw mo ako!#$e#Kaya, may bago ka bang maikukuwento sa akin?

records.source: It's hard to have fun on Sunday... I keep thinking about having to go to work tomorrow.$s
records.translation: Mahirap magsaya tuwing Linggo... Lagi kong naiisip na kailangan kong magtrabaho bukas.$s

records.source: Hi @.#$e#Hmm.. I wonder if I could grow a cactus in my room?
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#Hmm.. Makapagpapatubo kaya ako ng kaktus sa kuwarto ko?

records.source: Everyone's indoors during the winter, so I can play guitar as loud as I want.$h
records.translation: Nasa loob ang lahat tuwing taglamig, kaya maaari akong tumugtog ng gitara nang kasinglakas ng gusto ko.$h

records.source: Hi... Cold, isn't it?
records.translation: Kumusta... Malamig, hindi ba?

records.source: Oh, hi! It's good to see you again.#$e#Take it easy.
records.translation: Ah, kumusta! Ikinagagalak kitang makitang muli.#$e#Dahan-dahan lang.

records.source: Hi, @. Do you want to hang out or something?#$e#Well, it's a good time of year to catch up on all the sleep I've missed.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Gusto mo bang tumambay o ano?#$e#Aba, magandang panahon ito upang bumawi sa lahat ng tulog na nawala sa akin.$h

records.source: $d Joja#I hate working at JojaMart, but how else am I going to make money in this town?|I'm glad I work at the museum now. It's way more interesting than that depressing JojaMart ever was.
records.translation: $d Joja#Ayaw kong magtrabaho sa JojaMart, pero paano pa ako kikita sa bayang ito?|Natutuwa akong sa Museo na ako nagtatrabaho ngayon. Di-hamak na mas kawili-wili ito kaysa sa malungkot na JojaMart.

records.source: I think my Dad is coming back this spring.#$e#It's been 3 years since I've seen him. This is going to be strange.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko'y babalik si Tatay ngayong tagsibol.#$e#Tatlong taon ko na siyang hindi nakita. Magiging kakaiba ito.

records.source: Dad's been back for a while now. I guess I'm finally getting used to it.
records.translation: Matagal-tagal nang nakabalik si Tatay. Siguro ay nasasanay na rin ako sa wakas.

records.source: My Dad is in the military, fighting against the Gotoro Empire. That's why he's not here.#$e#He's coming back soon, though.
records.translation: Nasa militar si Tatay at nakikipaglaban sa Imperyo ng Gotoro. Kaya wala siya rito.#$e#Pero malapit na siyang bumalik.

records.source: One thing that's nice about winter... all the mosquitos are gone.
records.translation: Isang magandang bagay sa taglamig... wala na ang lahat ng lamok.

records.source: The worst thing about the snow is getting your feet soaked. You're lucky in those thick boots.
records.translation: Ang pinakamasama sa niyebe ay ang mabasa nang husto ang mga paa mo. Masuwerte ka sa makakapal na botang iyan.

records.source: I just remembered I need to change the strings on my guitar.#$b#Okay, I'm going to write a note on my wrist so I remember to do it tonight.#$e#I have to make little reminders for myself or else I'll totally forget to do things.$h
records.translation: Naalala ko lang na kailangan kong palitan ang mga kuwerdas ng gitara ko.#$b#Sige, magsusulat ako ng tala sa pulsuhan ko para maalala kong gawin iyon ngayong gabi.#$e#Kailangan kong gumawa ng maliliit na paalala para sa sarili ko, kung hindi ay lubos kong nalilimutang gawin ang mga bagay.$h

records.source: It would be fun if we could go sledding, wouldn't it?#$e#I don't think there are any good hills nearby.$s#$e#Plus, I don't have a sled.#$e#So, how have you been doing lately?
records.translation: Masaya sana kung makapagparagos tayo, hindi ba?#$e#Sa tingin ko'y walang magandang burol sa malapit.$s#$e#Bukod pa roon, wala akong paragos.#$e#Kaya, kumusta ka nitong huli?

records.source: Try not to make a mess in the house or my Mom will flip.
records.translation: Huwag kang magkalat sa bahay, kung hindi ay magwawala si Nanay.
